drafted_from: workflow:check-the-wake-alarm's own file, tools/workflows/recipes/check-the-wake-alarm.json (its two wakes and its one step), and the engine's wake settings retry and on_failure (trillion-rust 07ffdad66).
start_here: Say to your AI: "Check that my wake alarm still tells me when it fails." The AI switches on workflow:check-the-wake-alarm's wakes a-wake-that-fails and an-alarm-that-fails with your store as their input, waits about two minutes, reads wake:list and your notices, and switches both wakes off.
no_lists_because: It keeps one notice in the person's store (its notices table, the table workflow:read-my-notices reads) and reads nothing else; its one step reads a table that is kept nowhere, so that it fails for a real cause.
instructions: 1. Switch on the wakes a-wake-that-fails and an-alarm-that-fails with store as the input: where the person keeps their notices, its language and the vault name of its login.
2. Within a minute a-wake-that-fails runs and fails (the table it reads does not exist), and the engine keeps one wake-failed fact for it.

3. an-alarm-that-fails hears that fact, fails the same way, runs again after 20 s and again 40 s later, then keeps a needs-you notice titled 'The check of the wake alarm failed three times'. Read wake:list (its outcome and retrying) and the notice's created_at.
4. Switch both wakes off. The real alarm, workflow:tell-when-a-wake-stops, also tells you that a-wake-that-fails stopped.

worked_examples.title: The alarm copy fails three times and keeps its notice
worked_examples.ask: (the engine kept a wake-failed fact for the wake a-wake-that-fails of workflow:check-the-wake-alarm)

store.credential_name: the vault name of the person's database login

worked_examples.given: The engine kept wake-failed {tool workflow:check-the-wake-alarm, wake a-wake-that-fails, cause the database's answer that a_table_kept_nowhere_so_this_run_fails does not exist}.
worked_examples.hands_back: Three failed runs of an-alarm-that-fails, 20 s and 40 s apart, then one notice in the person's store titled 'The check of the wake alarm failed three times', kind needs-you.
